confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Japanese pricing. No live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked, and no web search was used for these anchors. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak summer travel season and Nara room rates move with Kyoto and Osaka demand. USD values assume Nara price levels at roughly 150 JPY per USD. Cocktail and wine_glass were set using the local price relationship to beer (about 1.5 to 1.6 times the beer anchor) because direct local knowledge is weaker. Beer serving size also varies by venue. hotel_3star_2p is the least certain anchor because Nara likely has fewer ordinary three-star hotels than Kyoto or Osaka, so its plausible range is wide.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Japan (East Asia). Nara is treated as a heritage day-trip and overnight city in the Kansai area. Lodging sits below central Kyoto and Osaka, while food and drink follow typical Japanese restaurant and cafe pricing, in line with other mid-sized Japanese tourist towns such as Kamakura and Nikko.
